The *Tipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 98) is a biographical verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. While the text itself has not received dedicated discussion in the surveyed reference literature, SuttaCentral lists five modern translations of the work across five languages [SuttaCentral].
Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus identifies curated parallels or high-scoring cross-language alignments in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, computational analysis by DharmaNexus indicates substantial internal Pali text reuse, registering twenty-five matching passages across seven texts [DharmaNexus]. Extensive formulaic passages are shared with other botanical and devotional narratives within the *Apadāna*, most notably the *Bodhivandakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 373; segments §1.3–4.4), *Tikiṅkaṇipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 493; segments §6.3–8.1), *Tikaṇṇipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 190; segments §5.4–8.1), *Tivaṇṭipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 192; segments §5.4–8.1), *Saḷalapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 270; segments §6.1–8.1), and *Rattipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 175; segments §6.3–8.1) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records seven matches with the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, part 1), with the longest match spanning segments §4.2–4.4 [DharmaNexus].
